title: GUIDE-seq Simplified Library Preparation Protocol for CRISPR/Cas9 Off-Target Detection
author: Nagendra Palani
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wikfccw
materials: This section of the protocol is from the manual for NEB Ultra II FS kit - Catalog # E7805. (Refer to https://www.neb.com/-/media/catalog/datacards-or-manuals/manuale7805.pdf : Section for Input > 100 ng for detailed protocol) Aliquot 400 ng of genomic DNA into a well of a 96-well plate and use 1x TE to bring the volume to 26 µL . Add the NEBNext Ultra II FS buffer + enzyme mix to the DNA (follow protocol from the linked manual) Set up the following program on the thermal cycler 75 °C, heated lid 37 °C for 00:10:00 65 °C for 00:30:00 4 °C hold. This should fragment the library to have a distribution between 300 - 700 bp. Add the NEBNext Ultra II ligation mix + enhancer to the well. Add 2.5 µL of the adaptor to the mixture. Mix well and incubate at 20 °C for 00:15:00, heated lid off . Post incubation, add 28.5 µL of 0.1x TE and bring volume to 100 µL . Perform bead clean-up of the ligation mix using the sample purification beads that came with the kit. Use 20 µL of beads for 1st bead addition 10 µL of beads for 2nd bead addition (to select for an insert size distribution of 350 - 600 bp). Elute in 17 µL of dH 2 O.

steps.title: Anneal TA adaptor oligos
steps.instruction: Prepare 100 µM stocks of Oligo TA_Adaptor_Top and Oligo TA_Adaptor_Bottom in 0.1× TE, then in a 0.2 mL PCR tube add 15 µL of each 100 µM oligo and 70 µL dH₂O (total 100 µL); vortex, spin down, place on a thermal cycler with heated lid at 95 °C for 3 min, then let the block cool to room temperature and leave the tube on the bench for 1 h to allow annealing.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 100 µM oligo stocks in 0.1× TE.
Mix 15 µL Top + 15 µL Bottom + 70 µL dH₂O in a 0.2 mL PCR tube (100 µL total).
Vortex, spin down, run 95 °C for 3 min (heated lid).
Cool to room temperature, then incubate on bench for 1 h for adaptor formation.

steps.title: First enrichment PCRs
steps.instruction: Dilute dsODN_Enrich_Plus, dsODN_Enrich_Minus and dsODN_Enrich_Adaptor to 10 µM; for each sample set up two PCRs in a 96‑well plate (PCR 1.1 and PCR 1.2) using 7.5 µL adaptor‑ligated DNA, 12.5 µL Ultra II Q5 master mix, 2.5 µL dsODN_Enrich_Adaptor and 2.5 µL of either dsODN_Enrich_Plus (PCR 1.1) or dsODN_Enrich_Minus (PCR 1.2) (25 µL total). Run the following program: 98 °C 30 s initial denaturation, 98 °C 10 s denaturation, 70 °C with –1 °C per cycle for 30 s, 72 °C 1 min annealing, then 7 cycles of 98 °C 10 s, 63 °C 30 s, 72 °C 1 min, followed by 13 additional cycles of the same, then hold at 4 °C. After PCR use 1 µL for Picogreen/Qubit quantification and 2 µL for Tapestation (D5000) size check; libraries should be unimodal 400–1300 bp with ≤15 % size variation across samples.

substeps.instruction: Make 10 µM dilutions of dsODN_Enrich_Plus, dsODN_Enrich_Minus, and dsODN_Enrich_Adaptor.
Set up PCR 1.1 (Plus strand enrichment) with 7.5 µL adaptor‑ligated DNA, 12.5 µL Ultra II Q5 master mix, 2.5 µL dsODN_Enrich_Adaptor, 2.5 µL dsODN_Enrich_Plus.
Set up PCR 1.2 (Minus strand enrichment) with the same volumes but 2.5 µL dsODN_Enrich_Minus.
Run the PCR program as described above.
QC: use 1 µL of each PCR product for Picogreen/Qubit; run 2 µL on a Tapestation (D5000) to verify a unimodal 400–1300 bp distribution and ≤15 % size variation.

steps.title: Indexing PCR
steps.instruction: Dilute Nextera_R1 and Nextera_R2 primers to 10 µM. For each sample combine 5 ng of PCR 1.1 product with 5 ng of PCR 1.2 product (10 ng total template). Set up a 20 µL PCR containing 10 µL Ultra II Q5 master mix, 1 µL Nextera_R1 (10 µM), 1 µL Nextera_R2 (10 ng), and water to volume. Run: 98 °C 30 s initial denaturation, 98 °C 10 s denaturation, 65 °C 30 s annealing, 72 °C 1 min extension, repeat for 10 cycles, then hold at 4 °C. After PCR use 1 µL for Picogreen/Qubit quantification.

substeps.instruction: Make 10 µM dilutions of Nextera_R1 and Nextera_R2 primers.
Mix 5 ng PCR 1.1 + 5 ng PCR 1.2 for each sample (10 ng template).
Prepare 20 µL PCR: 10 µL Ultra II Q5 master mix, 1 µL Nextera_R1, 1 µL Nextera_R2 (10 ng), add water to 20 µL.
Run PCR: 98 °C 30 s, 98 °C 10 s, 65 °C 30 s, 72 °C 1 min, 10 cycles, hold 4 °C.
QC: use 1 µL of the product for Picogreen/Qubit measurement.

steps.title: Pool, clean‑up and sequence
steps.instruction: Pool all indexed libraries by equal mass (assuming similar size distributions). Perform a 1.2× SPRI bead clean‑up and elute the pooled DNA in 30 µL 0.1× TE. Measure pool concentration with Picogreen/Qubit and quantify using the Kapa Illumina Library Quantification Kit. Dilute the pool to the molarity required for the sequencing instrument, load onto the sequencer, and run with a 15 % PhiX spike‑in for base diversity (MiSeq or other Illumina 4‑color platforms; increase PhiX if using NextSeq).

substeps.instruction: Pool libraries by equal mass (size distributions assumed similar).
Perform 1.2× SPRI bead cleanup; elute in 30 µL 0.1× TE.
Quantify pool with Picogreen/Qubit and Kapa Illumina Library Quantification Kit.
Dilute pool to the appropriate sequencing molarity.
Load on sequencer and run with 15 % PhiX spike‑in (adjust PhiX for NextSeq if needed).
